title: Meta:Context: a business context schema in dbt Semantic Layer
description:
Meta:Context: How Green Dot built a five-layer business context schema inside dbt's semantic layer to give AI agents interpretive judgment. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Keith Binkly, director of analytics and insights at Green Dot, explains that a semantic layer gets the query and the math right but doesn't tell an agent what a number means. Green Dot's Meta:Context schema adds five layers of business context in the same file as the metric, so it goes through the same pull requests and CI. When seven different AI models were asked to write a context card from raw materials, all flagged an untested claim appropriately.

In this session you'll learn:
• What a semantic layer cannot tell an AI agent
• How five layers of context live next to metric definitions
• How context gets reviewed like code

Speaker: Keith Binkly, director of analytics and insights, Green Dot

Learn more about the dbt Semantic Layer: https://www.getdbt.com/product/semantic-layer
